rules.name: scope_primary_and_explicit_actor_references
rules.interpretation: Target 18 decision/investment/trader sources, plus explicitly named same-run discussion roles; naming is not reliance.

rules.name: legacy_punctuation_slot_regression_scope
rules.interpretation: Also audit originating discussion texts where a legacy normalized value is punctuation-only. This is a structural-regression scope addition, not factual relevance or support.

rules.name: section_metadata_guard
rules.interpretation: Report section prefixes are metadata and never semantic predicates. Rating/action/target/horizon scalar fields are declarations, not imperative instructions or inferred semantic predications.

rules.name: sentence_frame
rules.interpretation: Surface punctuation frames; full paragraph/parent scope retained.

rules.name: discourse_and_author_position_guard
rules.interpretation: Administrative discourse abstains from market-fact normalization; author position is its own kind.

rules.name: semicolon_attachment_fence
rules.interpretation: Partition semicolon branches before reason/condition parsing, regardless of local viable() grammar. Typed condition guards stay local; unknown cross-branch scope is queued and full-frame cues remain context only.

rules.name: positive_and_negated_because
rules.interpretation: Separate declared/rejected reason clauses, preserving full reason frame; no causal validation.

rules.name: explicit_condition_branch
rules.interpretation: Parse bounded local prefix/suffix conditions within an R035 branch. Withhold unsupported postposed IF-after-colon or IF-comma-instruction attachments; nested/alternative Boolean scope remains unresolved.

rules.name: bounded_independent_coordination
rules.interpretation: Split only clauses with explicit subject/predicate or explicit imperative branches; no guessed shared subject.

rules.name: bounded_surface_slots
rules.interpretation: Parse exact surface slots after guards; no inferred coreference/time/unit attachment.

rules.name: explicit_imperative_action_slot
rules.interpretation: An explicit instruction verb/object may be retained with subject null; no inferred addressee, authorization or unconditional factual assertion.

rules.name: abstain_and_queue
rules.interpretation: Unsupported grammar and unresolved fields remain explicit.

rules.name: exact_input_handoff
rules.interpretation: Complete source in recorded input, same run and preceding output; presence not reliance.

rules.name: literal_rationale_overlap
rules.interpretation: Exact contiguous case-sensitive block at least 32 code points and five word tokens, plus separate whole-clause match; no semantic support claim.

rules.name: annotation_anchor_validation
rules.interpretation: Exact unique quote anchors validated; relation meaning remains worker-authored provisional interpretation.
